expertTips.tr: Uretim ortaminda degisiklik oncesi geri alma plani ve etki alanini not et.
expertTips.en: In production, note rollback plan and blast radius before making changes.

whenToEscalate.tr: Domain controller, cluster veya kritik servislerde tek basina degisiklik yapma; degisiklik penceresi ve onay al.
whenToEscalate.en: Do not change domain controllers, clusters, or critical services alone; use a change window and approval.
